molly (Docs): Quick heads-up: /v1/chat/completions doc has two problems in the example — it shows a top-level "result" array with "text" instead of the real "choices[].message.content" shape, and the Python snippet still uses the old openai.Completion.create pattern. We need a small fix before tomorrow's release.

sam (SDK): Thanks — can you paste the bad snippet and the expected shape? I'll update Python/JS samples.

molly (Docs): Bad snippet: ```json {"id":"cmpl-xxx","object":"chat.completion","result":[{"text":"Hi"}]} ``` Expected canonical: ```json {"id":"cmpl-xxx","object":"chat.completion","choices":[{"index":0,"message":{"role":"assistant","content":"Hi"}}] }``` Also the Python example should use `client.chat.create(...)` and reference `response.choices[0].message.content`.

sam (SDK): I'll open a docs PR to replace the response example, update code snippets, and add a brief migration note.

lee (Product): Include a 1-2 line migration blurb mapping old fields to new ones and link to migration doc. Keep it short.

molly (Docs): Drafted: "Note: legacy examples used a top-level "result" with "text". New responses use "choices[].message.content" — update parsing accordingly. See /docs/migrations/chat-response-shape." Will also add a tiny mapping snippet in the PR.

ana (Eng): Can you add a compact JSON Schema block so linting can validate the example? I can wire the linter rule if we include it.

molly (Docs): Good idea, adding a small schema inline.

deploy-bot: docs-build: queued (job 5220)
deploy-bot: docs-build: started (job 5220)

ana (Eng): Ran a quick check against staging — responses match choices[].message.content, no extra wrapper.

deploy-bot: docs-build: succeeded (job 5220) — preview: https://deploy-preview-1299--docs.redwood.ai/chat/completions

sam (SDK): PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1299 — updates: corrected response example, Python/JS snippet changes to client.chat.create, short migration note, and added JSON Schema. Requesting review from @molly and @lee.

molly (Docs): Reviewing now. One small nit: in the Python snippet please make the comment show `response.choices[0].message.content` explicitly so readers know where to pull text.

sam (SDK): Will do, pushing a quick commit. CI running.

deploy-bot: docs-build: succeeded (job 5221) — preview: https://deploy-preview-1300--docs.redwood.ai/chat/completions

sam (SDK): CI green and updated. Ready to merge pending your approve @molly.

molly (Docs): Approved and merged. Adding a changelog bullet under "Docs updates" for this week. :thumbsup:

sam (SDK): Filed follow-up to add a docs unit test asserting example JSON matches SDK output shape: infra#771.

molly (Docs): Great — closing thread. If anything else appears ping #docs. :sparkles:
